# Kapilesh Learning Solutions

> Kapilesh Learning Solutions is a premium leadership, capability and organisational transformation consulting practice founded by Kapilesh, who brings 34+ years of experience across sales leadership, Learning & Development and organisational capability building. The practice has trained and developed more than 20,000 professionals across industries. Core idea: building people who can build better organisations.

## Key facts

- Founder: Kapilesh
- Experience: 34+ years across sales leadership, L&D and organisational transformation
- Impact: 20,000+ professionals trained and developed
- Positioning: premium learning, leadership and organisational capability consulting - not a generic training vendor
- Philosophy: "Learning is valuable only when it changes the way people think, decide and act." Training is an event; capability is a journey.
- Approach: a four-stage process - Discover, Design, Develop, Transform
- Industries served: FMCG, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, Banking, Telecom, Power, Government, Education, Automobile
- Career: Area Business Manager at GlaxoSmithKline (1993-2004) -> Business Manager at Dumex India / Wockhardt (2004-2008) -> Lead Training Manager at HeroMindmine Institute / Hero Group (2008-2012) -> AVP and Head, Learning & Development at RSPL Group (2012-2026)
- Credentials: 5 Management Development Programs at IIM Ahmedabad; certifications from Thomas Assessments, KPMG, Lean Six Sigma, NIS Train-the-Trainer, and TUV SUD (PoSH)
- Coaching and mentoring: a core area of expertise, embedded within Leadership Development engagements alongside structured learning and real work application
- Contact: kapilesh@kapileshlearning.com / +91 93500 40594 / https://www.linkedin.com/in/kapileshthemotivator

## Consulting solutions

1. L&D Strategy & Governance - building L&D functions, learning architecture, governance systems and enterprise-wide capability strategies
2. Leadership Development - leadership pipelines, academies, succession development, coaching, mentoring and capability journeys
3. Organisational Transformation - mission, vision and values workshops, culture building, change management and engagement
4. Sales Excellence - sales leadership, consultative selling, strategic account management, negotiation and frontline capability
5. Trainer & Facilitator Development - Train-the-Trainer, training needs analysis, trainer certification and quality assurance
6. AI-Enabled Learning - practical AI tools, Prompt Engineering and emerging learning technology for everyday professional work
